sections.heading: Anthropic News: Claude ships computer use in the EU

claims.text: Anthropic expanded computer use for Claude to customers in the European Union.
evidence: Anthropic expanded computer use for Claude to customers in the European Union. The feature is generally available on the Messages API. Existing US and UK workspaces keep the same tool-calling contract. No pricing change.

sections.heading: OpenAI News: OpenAI cuts API prices for GPT-5 mini

claims.text: OpenAI announced a 50% price reduction for GPT-5 mini input tokens in the API, effective immediately for all prepaid and monthly billing accounts.
evidence: OpenAI announced a 50% price reduction for GPT-5 mini input tokens in the API, effective immediately for all prepaid and monthly billing accounts.

sections.heading: Anthropic News: Legacy Completions API sunset date

claims.text: Anthropic will deprecate the legacy Completions API on 15 January 2027.
evidence: Anthropic will deprecate the legacy Completions API on 15 January 2027. Migrate to Messages. This is a breaking API change for remaining Completions callers.

sections.heading: OpenAI News: New fine-tuning recipes for structured outputs

claims.text: The API now ships official fine-tuning recipes for structured outputs so teams can keep JSON schemas stable across model upgrades.
evidence: The API now ships official fine-tuning recipes for structured outputs so teams can keep JSON schemas stable across model upgrades.
